slot.brief: Given molality and observed vs theoretical freezing point depression, compute van 't Hoff factor and infer association/dissociation.

stem: A $0.10\ \text{m}$ aqueous solution of $\text{MCl}_2$ freezes at $-0.279^\circ\text{C}$. Given $K_\text{f}=1.86\ \text{K kg mol}^{-1}$ for water, find $i$ and the degree of dissociation.
working:
$\Delta T_\text{f,theoretical}=1.86\times0.10=0.186\ \text{K}$
$i=\dfrac{0.279}{0.186}=1.50$
For $\text{MCl}_2\rightleftharpoons\text{M}^{2+}+2\text{Cl}^-$, $i=1+2\alpha$
$\alpha=\dfrac{1.50-1}{2}=0.25=25\%$

Independent check: \(\Delta T_f=K_fmi\), so \(i=0.279/(1.86\times0.10)=1.50\). For \(\mathrm{MCl_2\to M^{2+}+2Cl^-}\), \(i=1+2\alpha\), giving \(\alpha=0.25\) (25%).
